description: This file defines a PHP trait 'BlockPluginTrait' used internally by Drupal's block system to provide base functionality for block plugins, including configuration management, access control, form handling, and transliteration services.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the block, either from configuration or plugin definition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration array.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration array, merging defaults and provided values.

methods.name: baseConfigurationDefaults
methods.description: Provides default configuration values for block plugins.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns plugin-specific default configuration.

methods.name: setConfigurationValue
methods.description: Sets a specific configuration key to a value.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for the block plugin.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access for a user account, returning boolean or object.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Default access check, allowing all by default.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds a configuration form for the block, including plugin-specific settings.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Placeholder for plugin-specific form elements.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the configuration form, unsets admin_label.

methods.name: blockValidate
methods.description: Placeholder for additional validation.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating configuration.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Placeholder for plugin-specific submit handling.

methods.name: getMachineNameSuggestion
methods.description: Generates a machine name suggestion based on admin label.

methods.name: getPreviewFallbackString
methods.description: Returns a fallback string for preview.

methods.name: transliteration
methods.description: Provides the transliteration service, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setTransliteration
methods.description: Sets the transliteration service.

methods.name: setInPreview
methods.description: Sets whether the plugin is in preview mode.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates whether to create a placeholder; defaults to FALSE.
